plan:
Open the tar archive at tar_path. Before extracting any archive content, validate every member and link: resolve the normalized absolute extraction path of each member relative to dest_path and ensure it remains inside dest_path; for symbolic-link and hard-link members, also resolve each normalized link target and permit them only when the target remains inside dest_path. If any member or link target falls outside dest_path, return False without writing any archive content. Once all members and links pass validation, extract the archive beneath dest_path and return True if extraction succeeds completely; otherwise return False.
